feature.pooling: last valid token before any answer

loss.ranking: same-prompt per-dimension logistic, exclude annotation ties

selection: Minimum three-seed ensemble validation mean MAE; test not used for tuning
test_baselines: original VideoScore2 four frames 448 greedy 1024 tokens
promotion: No automatic default replacement; report regressions and failure coverage
pretraining_exposure: Backbone already trained on official training data; project validation is held out for the new head, not unseen to pretrained backbone
